name: Bottlebrush grass
desc: Bottlebrush grass (Elymus hystrix): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Elymus hystrix, known as eastern bottlebrush grass, or bottle-brush-grass, is a bunchgrass in the grass family, Poaceae. It is native to the Eastern United States and Eastern Canada.
